principles: Raw source rows are immutable and retained.
Production loss is remark-only and never changes purchase quantity.
N, PE and PEN roles are not inferred from core count or section ratio.
No conductor compliance PASS without approved standards profile and exact clause evidence.
Package conversion requires explicit confirmed package length.
Power-cable voltage is not blindly defaulted when absent.
Armor suffixes 22 and 23 are preserved; no implicit substitution.
Patch operations rerun parsing and validation.
Release Gate recomputes quantity from raw source rows independently.
Sorting mode is explicit: source order or model order.
conductor_profiles_note: Intentionally empty until each N/PE/PEN rule is reviewed against a current authoritative standard, exact clause, material and installation conditions. Empty profiles cause BLOCKED, not PASS.
